Youtuber Dhruv Rathee alleges kidnapping after release

Youtuber Dhruv Rathee has alleged that he was kidnapped from his bedroom in Gurugram and held captive for 23 hours. Following his release, Rathee stated that his mother was pushed and his parents were beaten. He accused the government of sending "goons" to kidnap him and suggested that an "undeclared emergency" is in effect in the country. The coverage also notes that over 7,000 people have been detained so far, and questions remain about whether Rathee could face arrest again.
